reviews.title: Great case Lots of customization
reviews.comment: Great case. It seems well built and good quality.  Love the customization and cable management. Very easy to disassemble and work on. Love the fact the front panel connector is one plug and not five separate. It’s nice having the rgb header pre installed. There’s also plenty of room to add more rgb headers and ssd drives if needed. The front panel I/O can be relocated if needed, from the top to the side. The top will accommodate many different cooling options. Plus the front fans can be replaced with smaller ones. I’ve had no problems with temperatures with this case, and airflow is excellent. You are getting a lot for the price in my opinion.. Can’t recommend this case enough.
reviews.author: Pantherfan315

reviews.title: Solid Case with Great Features and Cooling
reviews.comment:
I went with this case for my latest build, and it’s been a really solid choice. It has a sleek look, but more importantly, it’s functional and easy to work with. It feels durable and well-made, which is what I was looking for.
There’s plenty of room inside, and it easily accommodates larger components without feeling cramped. Cable management was surprisingly smooth, and the built-in routing channels kept everything organized with minimal effort. Airflow has been great too, thanks to the included fans.
What I appreciated most was how user-friendly it is. The case design makes installation straightforward, and everything fit together nicely. The removable panels and tool-free features were a big help during setup.
Overall, if you’re after a roomy, well-designed case with good cooling and easy assembly, this is a great option. It checked all the boxes for me.
reviews.author: Juzgub

reviews.title: Bought it for the cooling - quite pleased
reviews.comment:
The air throughput is absolutely superb.
And that's coming from a guy running 3090 FE and a 13900KF (if you know, you know).
Basically a well functioning space heater rofl.
The removable glass panel is great for accessing internals quickly, and cable management absolutely sublime. Perfect negative pressure system I've ever used, though certainly could do positive. Those front fans are crazy good.
Caveats:
- I wish it was about an inch taller (from the base of power area) though so I could fit an extra gfx card on the bottom for more monitors.
- The SSD access isn't bad considering the airflow design, but wish it was a bit easier - as a guy who constantly works and switches drives.
- power management panel on bottom is a bit funky, but you get used to it and it grows on you.
- bit tight for the LGA1700+ chipset mobo's (gaming type boards have large heat sinks everywhere).
Pros:
- best cable management I've ever seen in a sub $300 case.
- best airflow period. feeding off previous: direct air pathways across board and heat sinks. HIGH volume. Unless you are building your own water cooling system (mobo, gfx, and cpu), and assuming you aren't using Peltier with liquid nitrogen, this is the best you're gonna get in my opinion.
- Tons of room considering it's not a "full tower".
Shoutout to GamersNexus for doing thorough reviews on all the latest and greatest computer cases, and I mean THOROUGH, which led me to this product. :)
reviews.author: Barry

reviews.title: Sleek Design with Excellent Airflow
reviews.comment:
I recently purchased the Lian Li 216 PC case, and it has exceeded my expectations. The sleek and minimalist design not only looks fantastic but also provides a functional and practical build experience. The tempered glass side panel beautifully showcases the internals, making it a great choice for those who want to display their components.
One standout feature is the outstanding airflow. The case comes with well-placed ventilation and fan options, keeping temperatures in check even during intense gaming sessions. Cable management is a breeze with ample space behind the motherboard tray, contributing to a clean and organized build.
The toolless drive installation is a nice touch, making the overall assembly process smooth and efficient. The case supports various cooling configurations, allowing for customization based on individual preferences and component choices.
While the case is compact, it offers plenty of room for high-end components, and the PSU shroud adds a neat and tidy look. The build quality is top-notch, reflecting Lian Li's commitment to craftsmanship.
In conclusion, the Lian Li 216 PC case is a fantastic choice for both aesthetics and performance. Whether you're a seasoned builder or a first-time PC enthusiast, this case delivers on style, functionality, and quality. Definitely of the best PC case in 2023. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Sergei Kardailskii

reviews.title: Amazing PC case
reviews.comment: I select this case for my next build, after watching few reviews videos at youtube.  My idea was to install a AIO cooling system at the top, and this case is ideal for that task because the top of the case can be removed and you can install the radiator outside the case and then replace this top part and done very easy.  The case have a lot of other flexibilities very convenient for components installations and cable management. Be aware that if you want to use the area below the MB, in which are two removable grills to installing 2.5" SSD you will need sata extensions in straight angle, PS sata cables came in  90 degrees.  Also this case have an option to install the MB in two positions lower (default) and upper, if you leave the standup in their default location you will not be allow to use the fan at the back of the case.  Otherwise I think is a great case and at the moment with the fans included and the AIO, the case has a good air flow and temp at the cpu are under 60 degrees Celsius under normal use.
